recon.extraction_guidance: PRIMARY EXTRACTABLE DATA: Table 4 is the only table with actual mineral concentrations and should be the focus of extraction. Extract Acer pseudo-platanus and Fagus sylvatica separately. For Acer: use 390 ppm as control vs 520 and 650 ppm as two separate elevated treatments. For Fagus: same structure. Note that N, K, Ca, Mg are in %, Mn and Fe in ppm. No variance values are available - extraction will be means only. Figure 2 provides relative percentage data for herbaceous species (Trifolium repens/Lolium perenne mixture and Trifolium pratense/Festuca pratensis mixture) but actual concentration means are not given in the paper for herbaceous species - only percent change from control and significance. If extracting Figure 2 data, note that values represent mixed-species composites and the control = 100% baseline. DO NOT extract from Table 5 (extrapolated estimates). DO NOT confuse total mineral amounts (Tables 2, 3) with concentrations. Flag all extractions as having n=1 replication for Experiments I and II, limiting meta-analytic weight.
